title: V. G. Kapussir, Applicant To Join The S. M. Police Specials

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch, Shanghai.
REPORT
File No. 5867/90
Date. September 23. 1939

Subject V.G. Kapustin, applicant to join the S.M.Police (Specials.)

Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by. G. Crawford. 89

Vladimir Grigorievich KAPUSTIN, Russian, born
on February 24, 1908, at Blagoveshchensk, Amur Region, Si-
beria. According to his own statement, he left Russia
for Manchuria in 1918 together with his parents and sub-
sequently proceeded to Shanghai via Japan arriving in
this city in 1919. Here he attended the Thomas Hanbury
School from 1919 to 1926, after which he went to Harbin
to join parents. For the following 13 years he resided
for various periods in different towns in China includ-
ing Harbin ( 1926-1929 ), Tientsin ( 1929 - 1931 and
1933 - 1939 ) and Tairen ( 1931 - 1933 ) occasionally
visiting Shanghai and Hongkong. During this period he
was engaged in commercial activities in connection with
the firm G.Kapustin & Co., owned by his father. He ar-
rived in Shanghai from Tientsin in May, 1939, & at present
is a partner in the United Transporters of Shanghai, 113
Kiukiang Road, representing his father's interests in this
business.

He holds passport No 1551 issued on 23-6-33 by
the Police Bureau of Greater Tientsin and is registered
with the Russian Emigrants Committee in Shanghai. At
present he resides at the Navy Y.M.C.A., 630 Szechuan Road,
Room 527, while his parents and two brothers ( Vit. G.
Kapustin and B.J. Kapustin ) reside at 34 Route de Say
Zoong.

While in Shanghai he did not come to notice of
the Municipal Police in connection with any activities
of an undesirable character.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
上海特别支部第一科。
报告
档案号 5867/90
日期：1939年9月23日

事由：V.G. 卡普斯京（V.G. Kapustin），申请加入上海公共租界警务处（特别队）。

呈报人：侦探副督察普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev）。转呈人：G. 克劳福德（G. Crawford）。89

弗拉基米尔·格里戈里耶维奇·卡普斯京（Vladimir Grigorievich KAPUSTIN），俄国人，1908年2月24日出生于西伯利亚阿穆尔州布拉戈维申斯克。据其自述，他于1918年随父母离开俄国前往满洲，随后经日本前往上海，于1919年抵达本市。在此之后，他于1919年至1926年间就读于汉璧礼西童公学（Thomas Hanbury School），此后前往哈尔滨与父母团聚。在接下来的13年里，他在中国不同城镇断续居住，包括哈尔滨（1926-1929年）、天津（1929-1931年及1933-1939年）和大连（1931-1933年），期间偶尔访问上海和香港。在此期间，他从事与其父亲所有的G.卡普斯京公司（G.Kapustin & Co.）有关的商业活动。他于1939年5月从天津抵达上海，目前是九江路113号上海联合运输公司（United Transporters of Shanghai）的合伙人，代表其父亲在该业务中的利益。

他持有由天津特别市警察局于1933年6月23日签发的第1551号护照，并在上海俄国侨民委员会登记。目前他居住在四川北路630号海军青年会（Navy Y.M.C.A.）527室，而其父母及两个兄弟（Vit. G. Kapustin 和 B.J. Kapustin）居住在赛宗路（Route de Say Zoong）34号。

在上海期间，他未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

G.I. Kapustin, father of the applicant, is the
owner of the firm G. Kapustin & Co in Tientsin, dealing
in furs and skins. Since 1933 the firm has a branch of-
fice in Shanghai at present located at 374 Kiangsi Road.
Apart from this he is a partner in the Soskin Siberian
Fur Store, 1119 Bubbling Well Road, and the Niagara Aerated
Waters Co., 418 Route Prelupt. According to police re-
port dated 29-6-33, he was, for some time, suspected of
being one of the most important importers of narcotics
in Tientsin.

                                        G. Prokopiev
                                        D. S. I.

申请人之父 G.I. 卡普斯京（G.I. Kapustin）是天津 G. 卡普斯京公司（G. Kapustin & Co.）的所有人，经营毛皮和皮革生意。自1933年以来，该公司在上海设有分公司，现位于江西路374号。此外，他还是静安寺路1119号索斯金西伯利亚皮货店（Soskin Siberian Fur Store）以及蒲石路418号尼亚加拉汽水公司（Niagara Aerated Waters Co.）的合伙人。根据1933年6月29日的警务报告，他曾一度被怀疑是天津最重要的毒品进口商之一。
